data.body:
LIVE APPLY ATTEMPTED (operator-authorized) — PARTIAL SUCCESS, blocked exactly as the blast-radius AC predicted.

Environment: worktree /Users/joeoakhart/close-b928 at origin/main 25ea12c200ae (fix 13e2ea6decc9c62484f80034e28cb96c20448ea2 confirmed ancestor); AWS_REGION=us-east-1; remote state s3://rebar-tfstate-896586841071/rebar/prod/terraform.tfstate.

PLAN (fresh, `terraform plan -out=rubied.plan`) matched the recorded envelope EXACTLY — `Plan: 6 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy`:
  add: aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm.mcp_mem_abort, aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm.mcp_retire_cap, aws_ssm_parameter.rebar_secrets[".../mcp-client-pat-claude", ".../mcp-client-pat-codex", ".../mcp-client-pat-copilot", ".../mcp-tickets-pat"]
  change: aws_instance.gerrit in-place (user_data 1cfc59bd… -> a0a37e6b…)
  destroy: none; no replacements; the 3 jira import blocks: no-op (adopted).

APPLY (`terraform apply rubied.plan`) — REAL OUTPUT:
  ✓ aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm.mcp_mem_abort   — Creation complete [id=rebar-autodeploy-mcp-mem-abort]
  ✓ aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm.mcp_retire_cap  — Creation complete [id=rebar-autodeploy-mcp-retire-cap]
  ✓ aws_ssm_parameter.rebar_secrets["/rebar/prod/mcp-tickets-pat"] — Creation complete
  ✓ aws_instance.gerrit — Modifications complete after 3m48s [id=i-00880b2c7f13527c5] (user_data updated; box stop/start completed)
  ✗ aws_ssm_parameter.rebar_secrets["/rebar/prod/mcp-client-pat-copilot"] — Error 400 ParameterAlreadyExists
  ✗ aws_ssm_parameter.rebar_secrets["/rebar/prod/mcp-client-pat-claude"]  — Error 400 ParameterAlreadyExists
  ✗ aws_ssm_parameter.rebar_secrets["/rebar/prod/mcp-client-pat-codex"]   — Error 400 ParameterAlreadyExists

This is precisely the failure the checked "blast radius" AC forecast: those three params already exist in AWS at version 1 with NO `import` block, so `terraform apply` fails `ParameterAlreadyExists` partway. Post-apply re-plan (`-lock=false`) confirms the ONLY residual delta is those three: `Plan: 3 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`.

CONSEQUENCE FOR CLOSE: the P1 SUBJECT of this bug (templatefile()/user_data breakage) is fully resolved and now APPLIED end-to-end through remote state — plan completes, and the gerrit user_data in-place update applied successfully, proving the S3-remote-state path works. BUT the live-validation AC and the DoD box both require a SUCCESSFUL apply with the SSM creates adopted (no ParameterAlreadyExists). Reaching a clean apply requires adding `import` blocks for the three mcp-client-pat-* params to `ssm.tf`, which is owned by the concurrent SSM value_wo migration agent (I was instructed not to touch `ssm.tf`/`finedrawn`). I have therefore NOT checked the two live-validation boxes, NOT closed, and NOT used --force. Escalating to the operator: either the SSM agent lands the import blocks (then a clean re-apply + close), or the operator decides how to reconcile the three pre-existing params.

Artifacts (in worktree close-b928): rubied.plan (saved plan), rubied.apply.log, rubied.replan.log.
